summary: Wide gravel pull-off on a bend, forest behind, vehicles already stopped there.
reasons: Large gravel apron off the lane

best_section.where: Gravel apron on the inside of the bend, west of the road, just at the pin

drivers.seclusion: Forest on the west and north, quarry cut to the south east; no dwellings anywhere in view.
drivers.access_and_room: Bare gravel meets the road edge with room for several vehicles clear of the traffic lane.
drivers.traffic: Two lane scenic road runs along the apron, with quarry traffic and sightseers.
drivers.convention: Several cars and a white van or camper stopped on the gravel in both images.

flags: Road noise and passing traffic beside the apron
Slope about 2% at the pin, steeper beyond
Exposed bend, headlights from passing vehicles
sun_shade: Open to the sky, with trees shading the west edge in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Night closures of the road or quarry
